items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Mark came into the session. I had asked him to play three tunes... On that record when we improvised together

ctx.x: And another one with Rich Perry a few years before that for Steeplechase. Do you remember those dates at all?

Yeah I do. There were some nice moments with Rich Perry. Mark came into the session. I had asked him to play three tunes or something like that and I remember him coming in and taking out his horn and setting up a metronome and warming up.
